title: Top AI coding assistants fail one in four tasks, revealing serious gaps between hype and actual performance reliability | TechRadar
summary: AI coding assistants, including advanced proprietary and open source models, struggle with structured-output tasks, with failure rates of one in four and average accuracies of 75% and 65% respectively, indicating significant room for improvement.
sentiment_reason: The article highlights issues such as high failure rates and moderate accuracy in AI coding assistants, which can lead to negative implications for their adoption in professional development environments.
